Fraction of the preserved sample actually examined under the scope (1 = whole sample). Counts are NOT divided by this: the sorter deliberately did not adjust for aliquot, since the study measures occurrence rather than density (Notes sheet, 2015-10-22). Treat it as context for interpreting an absence.
